name: Klyf
description: Bring your YouTube channel into Claude and just ask. Audit your channel to see where you're losing watch time and which video to fix first. Get ideas for what to make next, drawn from your own comments and best-performing videos. Understand who your audience is and what they keep asking for. Package a title and thumbnail before you publish, or draft comment replies in your own voice. Useful for planning your next upload, fixing an underperformer, prepping a launch, and keeping up with your comments.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Klyf to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Klyf to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://klyf.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Klyf MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Klyf lists 20 MCP tools, including analyze_audience, analyze_video, audit_channel, check_discoverability, check_growth, diagnose_channel, draft_description, enable_auto_reply, evaluate_idea, find_best_thumbnails, find_best_videos, and get_weekly_digest.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Klyf?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Klyf in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Klyf requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Klyf is developed by Klyf. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
